name: Cecil
source:
A shy business student attending school with Lucie to take over his family's gem mining business. He lives with Lucie at her brother's apartment.

"Well, either way you'll still be impressive, I think. Whatever you decide, Lucie, we'll still be together, so don't worry too much."

Dislikes: feeling forced into doing things, having the future planned too far out
Likes: taking strolls to new places, sitting with Leroy

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/]Steam[/url]]
